title: The settings API saves invalid field mappings
subtitle: TAVI CRM / Desk (staging, tenant NDC-Staging) vs Zoho help docs / NDC-1669

panels.caption: Expected validation
text: Zoho maps fields through dropdowns of existing fields only; no free-form field keys can be saved.
TAVI's own error codes for these cases exist in the app: crm_field_unknown, desk_field_unknown, lookup_not_mappable, incomplete.
